statement: A schema observation identifies the exact subtree snapshot vector and reports a sorted complete inventory of observed active fields and FactValue tags, not write constraints or a graph-global sequence.

frames.note: Starts the request and validates the returned schema after the server replies.
Routes the graph schema request to its coordinator facade.
Reads all leaves under a leased cut, merges fields, and fails if complete response limits are exceeded.
Requires a non-empty unique snapshot vector, snapshotSeq equal to its maximum sequence, unique canonical fields, and known unique value tags.

consequence: Consumers can identify the read snapshot and must not mistake the observed inventory for schema enforcement or completeness of a data import.
